title: Wall Mount Double Glass Shelf 16-Inch With Gallery Rail - Waverly Place Collection | Flat Troll Blue | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf that adds two levels of organization while keeping essentials neatly in place in Flat Troll Blue, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary bathroom designs.

  • Flat Troll Blue creates a distinctive focal point
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass hardware supports enduring performance
  • Gallery rail designed to help keep items from sliding off
  • Concealed screw mounting for a clean, streamlined look

Specs

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
  • Overall dimensions: 16 inches L x 5 inches W x 8 inches H
  • Projection: 5 inches
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4)

Designed to coordinate with the Waverly Place collection for a transitional look and versatile bath accessories. Multiple designer finish options are available.
